meta.description: SARANG — clothing and accessories for men and women. Pre-order with delivery across Tashkent, no online payment.

preorder.title: How pre-ordering works

steps.title: Place a pre-order
steps.text: Choose the item, size and colour, then leave your name and phone number. There is no online payment.

steps.title: We call you
steps.text: Our manager contacts you to confirm the order, the price and the delivery terms.

steps.title: We deliver
steps.text: Once confirmed, your order is brought from China and delivered to you. Payment is arranged by agreement.

columnsHelp: name, price, category, gender, sizes, colors — required.
name_ru, description_ru, name_en, description_en — optional translations. If empty, the Uzbek text is shown.
sizes / colors / images — several values separated by “|”: S|M|L.
category: tshirts, shirts, knitwear, outerwear, trousers, dresses, skirts, accessories.
colors: black, white, cream, beige, grey, charcoal, navy, sky, olive, brown (or the Uzbek name).
unavailable: options that are not available, e.g. XL:black|S:white.
status: active / inactive / archived. If empty: with images — active, without — inactive.
Files saved by Excel with “;” also work — the separator is detected automatically.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: All figures are calculated from order records.
analytics.demoNote: SAMPLE DATA: these figures are calculated from test orders created in this browser. They are not real business results.
analytics.emptyText: Analytics fill in automatically as real orders arrive. Revenue is calculated only from the amount received for orders with the “Delivered” status.
analytics.emptyPeriod: No data for this period. Choose another period.
analytics.outcomes: Outcome of orders placed in the period
analytics.topNote: Units in orders placed in the period and not cancelled. The amount is the price at the time of order, not revenue.
definitionsList: Revenue = the amount actually received for orders with the “Delivered” status. Cancelled orders and orders not yet delivered are not counted as revenue.
Revenue is grouped by delivery date; the number of orders is grouped by order date.
Best sellers: units in orders placed in the period that were not cancelled.
Profit is not calculated — costs and expenses will be added in a later version.

about.title: About us
about.lead: We are a small team in Tashkent. We select clothing and accessories from trusted manufacturers in China and bring them to Uzbekistan.
paragraphs: We check every product ourselves, paying attention to fabric quality, cut and stitching. We only offer things we would wear ourselves.
We work on a pre-order basis. This means we don't hold excess stock and can keep our prices fair.
For now we deliver across Tashkent, and soon across all of Uzbekistan.
